chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'The water of Zamzam is the best water upon the surface of the earth, and the most evil water upon the surface of the earth is the water of Barhout which is at Hadramawt — the souls of the disbelievers come to it at night.'

key_terms.بَرَهُوتَ: Barhout (also Barhut), a deep valley or well in Hadramawt (Yemen) described in hadith literature as a gathering place for souls of the wicked
key_terms.مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ: The water of the Zamzam well, located inside the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca, miraculously appeared for Hagar and Ishmael and is considered blessed
key_terms.هَامُ الْكُفَّارِ: The souls/spirits of the disbelievers; in classical Arabic, 'hama' (pl. 'ham') can refer to the spirit or shade of the dead

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the water of Zamzam and Barhout?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a saying of Imam Ali (AS) establishing a sacred and eschatological cosmology of water: Zamzam, the blessed spring at the Ka'ba in Mecca, is the best water on earth, while Barhout — a valley in Hadramawt, Yemen — is the worst, serving as a nocturnal gathering place for the souls of disbelievers. This teaching reflects the Shia understanding of sacred geography and the spiritual dimension of the natural world, connecting earthly locations to their otherworldly significance.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The water of Zamzam is the best water upon the surface of the earth, and the most evil water upon the face of the earth is water of Barhout which is at Hazramowt (near Yemem), receiving a significant number of Infidels at night’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ariy from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘
The water of Zamzam is the best water on earth. The worst water on earth is the water of Barhut which is in Hadra maxvt upon which wandering unbelievers roam during the night.’”
